As Principal Data Scientist, you will lead the design and delivery of machine learning and analytics solutions that improve how Amtrak runs its railroad. Working alongside operating and engineering teams, you will turn real operational problems into models, tools, and decisions that reach the field, and you will help set the standards that make our data science practice repeatable and effective.

• Interprets and analyzes data using exploratory mathematic and statistical techniques based on the scientific method.
• Coordinates research and analytic activities utilizing various data points (unstructured and structured) and employ programming to clean, massage, and organize the data.
• Works closely with all business units and engineering teams to develop strategy for long term data platform architecture.
• Leads all data experiments.

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education, training and/or relevant experience.
• Plus 7 years of relevant work experience.
• Strong Python and SQL experience.
• Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining models and data pipelines in Databricks or a comparable lakehouse platform (Spark, Delta, MLflow).

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education, training and/or relevant experience.
• Plus 9 years of relevant work experience.
• Cloud experience (AWS or Azure).
• Experience embedding with business or operations teams to deliver solutions in their workflow.
• Familiarity with modern ML and AI tooling.
• Backgorund in operations, transporation, or another data-rich physical industry.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Requires an advanced analytical knowledge of data.
• Ability to conduct large data analysis.
• Ability to perform data conditioning for storage/moving capability.
• Ability to program advanced computing.
• Ability to develop algorithms, software and data models.
• Ability to execute predictive analytics.

Overview

The Data Scientist supports all Data Acquisition, Analytics, and Governance Services tasks and the strategy, design, and deployment of all advanced analytical and AI/ML models for the Office of Naval Research (ONR) Comptroller's Office Data and Analytics (D&A) Division architecture.

Responsibilities

• Provide comprehensive technical infrastructure support for all systems supporting the data and analytics environment.
• Design, deploy, and operate all data and applications within a cloud environment authorized at the FedRAMP High baseline and DoD Impact Level 5 (IL5), and maintain the system's Authority to Operate (ATO) at all times lo include configuration management, security patching, system monitoring, and help desk support.
• Support the architecture design for scalability to accommodate future growth in data volume and user load.
• Sustain secure data access mechanisms, including Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and user interfaces for data exploration, as well as a secure Bulk Data Download capability for authorized users.
